Knowledge Artifact Metadata
Name (machine-readable) TrustDemoIND01
Title (human-readable) TD.IND.01 Foreign doses imported as verified
Status Draft
Experimental true
Description

Of the foreign DVCs a clinic scans to verify, the proportion whose dose is recorded as verified.
Measure Steward litlfred
Steward Contact Details litlfred: https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo
Measure Metadata
Version Number 0.1.0
Measure Scoring Proportion
Guidance

A definition only: it states no target and no value. Data elements: TD.J3A.DE02 Issuing country; TD.J3A.DE03 Verified at; TD.J3A.DE05 Verification result; TD.J3A.DE07 Failure reason; TD.J3A.DE09 Record outcome. Decision tables: TD.DT.01. Requirements: STT-VER-001, STT-VER-006, STT-VER-008. The populations are described, not computable: this guide carries no CQL.
Measure Population Criteria
Denominator Description:

Foreign DVCs scanned for verification in the reporting period.
Numerator Description:

Foreign DVCs scanned for verification in the reporting period whose dose was recorded as verified.
Stratifier Code: Record outcome
Description: verified, reported-unverified, rejected, not-read (TD.DT.01)
Stratifier Code: Failure reason
Description: the STT-VER-008 reason, for DVCs that did not verify
Stratifier Code: Issuing country
Description: the participant that signed the DVC
Stratifier Code: Facility
Description: the clinic that verified
